text: A song of ascents.Those trusting in the Lord are like Mount Zion,unshakable, forever enduring. [AA]
As mountains surround Jerusalem,the Lord surrounds his peopleboth now and forever. [AB]
The scepter of the wicked will not prevailin the land allotted to the just, [1]Lest the just themselvesturn their hands to evil.
Do good, Lord, to the good,to those who are upright of heart. [AC]
But those who turn aside to crooked waysmay the Lord send down with the evildoers. [AD]Peace upon Israel! [AE]
